name: Solis DAL AI Agents
description: A suite of LangGraph-based A2A agents for schema mapping, schema analysis, and GraphQL query generation

capabilities.description: Generate mappings between GraphQL schemas based on natural language queries

query.description: Natural language description of mapping requirements
query.example: Map concert vulnerabilities to turbo entities

returns.mapping_result: Complete mapping structure with property relationships

capabilities.description: Analyze and find relevant GraphQL schemas using semantic similarity

query.description: Search query for finding relevant schemas

capabilities.description: Generate an executable GraphQL query (plus title & report) from natural language

query.description: Natural language description of the data you want
query.example: List all services with error rates above 1% last month

returns.title: A concise title for the query
returns.report: A natural-language summary of the results
